title: Bedroom paint
topic: A friend estimates gallons of paint for two coats on four bedroom walls
blurb: Subtract the door and windows, double for two coats, and buy three gallons.
prompt: A friend texted this from the paint aisle. Tap a line if the estimate is off, or call it clean.

segments.label: The walls
segments.text: Repainting the bedroom — four walls total 440 sq ft, minus 60 sq ft for the door and two windows, so 380 sq ft of actual wall.

segments.label: The label
segments.text: One gallon covers 350 sq ft, and I'm putting on two coats.

segments.label: The buy
segments.text: Two coats is 760 sq ft, so two gallons come up short — grabbed three gallons and I'll have most of the third can left over.

segments.label: The relief
segments.text: Glad I didn't try to stretch two cans.

conclusion: 380 sq ft times two coats is 760 sq ft, which exceeds two 350 sq ft cans, so three cans leave most of the third unused.
